title: Fantastic tour experience!
text:
Javi was fantastic from the time I made my booking to the day of the actual tour - excellent communication and provided me with link to buy the tickets to the Alhambra.  Our tour started on time and we walked through the Alhambra at a good pace, not feeling rushed.  Javi was an excellent storyteller; giving us an in-depth explanation of the history and culture of the Alhambra, Granada and the region.   As well, Javi did a fantastic job being our photographer; the photos were absolutely beautiful.

title: Fantastic!
text: Fernando was FANTASTIC! We had such a wonderful time on our tour; he kept things interesting for our three young boys and was a great story teller. It was also nice not to have to worry about keeping track of the time and logistics so we could just enjoy the palaces and gardens. Highly recommend!
author: Michelle_F

title: Alhambra is a must visit. This exceptional tour elevates your experience to another level!
text: It goes without saying that if you travel to Spain, you MUST at some point visit Granada and see the Alhambra. There are a lot of tour options, but this one is exceptional! Many tours include the entry ticket into Nasrid Palace, with a marked up price per person. I especially appreciated being able to obtain tickets myself via the official website and have the timing tour based on our entry time slot. Our guide, FERNANDO , was absolutely outstanding! title: Great private Alhambra tour - highly recommended!
text: Fantastic private tour with Javi. Super knowledgeable who navigated us through the busier areas of the Alhambra with ease. Great relaxed pace - we never felt rushed - and made sense of what would have otherwise been an overwhelming monument. Worth the cost and highly recommended!
author: KT_in_EuropeAgain

title: Alhambra with Javier
text: Javier responded promptly and efficiently to our Saturday afternoon request to book a 3H guided tour for Monday morning. He was friendly and knowledgable and really went the extra mile for us. Strongly recommend !.
author: Dream35454159032

title: A guide is highly recommended for this experience
text: Our guide Cristian was superb. Extremely knowledgeable and engaging. The whole family enjoyed the experience.
author: Donna_K

title: Excellent tour with Javi!
text:
Our first time visiting Spain/Alhambra, wanted to make the most of our experience and decided to book a private tour guide. And, I’m so glad I did! Our guide was Javier “Javi”, and he was EXCELLENT! We could not have been more pleased with our tour. Javi was extremely knowledgeable about the region, the Alhambra, and all its history. He was passionate about the history. And, so patient with our questions. I highly recommend this tour and if considering, certainly seek out and inquire about Javier as your guide. 
Thank you Javi, Stacey and Jeff Angelini
author: Stacey_A

title: The Best Guide ever
text: I would give him 10 stars. I highly recommend our local tour guide Javier. I use a mobility scooter and I booked this private tour from the U.S because of the description. We communicated using whatsapp and he was right on time to meet our tour bus. His knowledge of the Alhambra and ability to navigate the site allowed me access using ramps. He was the best guide I have had in over 45 years of international travel.
author: Michael_K

title: Fantastic, passionate and knowledgeable guide!
text: Javi was the most fantastic guide ! He was so helpful even before we met and he made our experience in Granada and the Alhambra so special and memorable!  He is passionate about his work and it really shows. We had a great morning learning about the Alhambra and he shared so many recommendations about things to do and places to eat which made our stay in Granada so enjoyable. Thank you Javi!
